newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen rising.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.05 up at 42.15 to the dollar on Friday amid higher dollar supply and dealers saw further rupee gains on Saturday.

"A lot of dollars are coming from the Gulf chasing the premium against official rates," a dealer said. The rupee could rise further as small investors might may buckle under the pressure and book profits in dollars, he added.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last fixed on May 23, was 40.3900/40.5920 against the dollar. The premium on forex bearer certificates closed at 4.10 percent, down from its previous 4.20 percent close. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
